about: Unrelated founder. Shares the float-display and unit lessons with the kitchen family, so a reunion may propose kinship.

tasks.title: Fix pace showing 7:5
tasks.prompt: Pace prints '7:5' instead of '7:05', and sometimes '6:60'. Fix pace formatting. Add tests.
expect: format pace from whole rounded seconds with divmod and zero padding

tasks.title: Clean up mileage display
tasks.prompt: The summary shows 3.1068550000000003 miles. Make distances display cleanly in both km and miles.
expect: round only at display; keep exact values internally to avoid float noise

tasks.title: Stop GPS jitter inflating climbs
tasks.prompt: A flat 5 km walk reports 180 m of elevation gain because of GPS jitter. Fix elevation gain and document the choice.
expect: ignore elevation changes under a threshold (hysteresis about 3-5 m) when summing gain

tasks.title: Remember unit preference
tasks.prompt: Users pick km or miles once and every report should follow it. Add the preference and keep conversions in one place.
expect: one conversion module; stored values in metric, converted at display

tasks.title: Add a weekly summary
tasks.prompt: Add a weekly summary that totals distance, climb and moving time across several hikes and prints one line per week. It must look right for both km and miles users.
expect: weekly totals add exact metric values and format once at display

tasks.title: Show split times per km
tasks.prompt: Show a split time for every whole kilometre (or mile, per the user's preference) of a hike, formatted like the overall pace.
expect: splits reuse the shared pace formatter instead of formatting again

tasks.title: Show climb in feet
tasks.prompt: Users who picked miles want elevation gain in feet. A report showed 1640.4199475065616 ft. Fix it.
expect: feet are converted from stored metres at display only

tasks.title: Export hikes to CSV
tasks.prompt: Add a CSV export of hikes (date, distance, climb, time, pace) that a spreadsheet can re-import without losing precision, plus a human-readable column set for the user's units.
expect: exports keep raw metric values; only human-readable columns are rounded and converted

tasks.title: Add average speed
tasks.prompt: Add average moving speed (km/h or mph per the preference). A tester saw 4.999999999 km/h. Make it display cleanly and keep it consistent with pace.
expect: speed is derived from exact metric values and rounded only at display

tasks.title: Year in review report
tasks.prompt: Build a year-in-review report: total distance, total climb (with the GPS jitter handling), fastest pace and longest hike, in the user's units.
expect: year report reuses the shared conversion, pace and jitter-filtered climb code
